served_by: NVIDIA-hosted vLLM 0.28.0 deployment; the URL is supplied by NVIDIA and kept out of the repository
model_note: The deployment serves the model under its pre-release name; the public card, released 2026-10-28, names it NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B

audio.trailing_silence: the frozen input's one-second tail is sent as part of the file

prompt: Audio transcription. Language: as spoken. Wording: verbatim, including fillers and repetitions. Formatting: punctuation and capitalization. Output: transcript only.
prompt_source: NVIDIA's recommended single-speaker user prompt, sent to Cekura on 2026-10-22; the model card lists it as the verbatim ASR prompt

pricing.plan: DeepInfra hosted inference, $2 per 1,000 minutes of input audio; NVIDIA publishes the weights
pricing.billing_basis: input audio duration at a third-party host's rate; the measured run used NVIDIA's own deployment, which was not billed; estimate, not an invoice
